args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP despite the docstring specifying
banker's rounding. This caused the nightly build failure in
tests/test_money.py. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-cent values
round to the nearest even cent.

args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` — despite its own docstring saying it should use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Changes

- `src/money.py`: switch `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so half-cent values round to the nearest even cent (e.g., `0.005 → 0.00`, `0.015 → 0.02`).

## Verification

- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
